title: Public Concern About Immigration and Customer Complaints Against Minority Financial Advisors
authors: Kelvin K. F. Law; Luo Zuo
eligible_reason: Treatment is continuous and time-varying: nonwhite (or Hispanic/Black/API) advisor indicator x scaled Baker-Bloom-Davis immigration-fear index (annual, national), with advisor FE and year x firm x county FE. Table 10-type analyses use a continuous beta. No binary staggered adoption.
